title: U.S. House, District 28
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 28th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Roster from CBS Miami primary roundup and Florida Politics: Carlos Gimenez (R) and Phil 'Felipe' Ehr (D) were each unopposed in their primaries; Eddy Rojas (NPA) makes it a three-way November race. Sources: https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/live-updates/2026-florida-primary-live-updates-results/ ; https://floridapolitics.com/archives/819963-a-powerful-moral-compass-jamie-raskin-backs-phil-ehr-as-veterans-bike-across-cd-28-for-him/ ; https://ehrforcongress.us/ Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Carlos Gimenez
candidates.photo_source: congress.gov member portrait (bioguide ID from memory, unverified)
candidates.occupation: U.S. Representative (since 2021); former Miami-Dade County Mayor
candidates.background: Carlos Gimenez, a former Miami fire chief and Miami-Dade County mayor (2011-2020), has represented the 28th District since January 2021 (elected in the old 26th). He was unopposed in the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary. In 2026 he has publicly urged the administration to change its ICE enforcement strategy and to 'normalize' longtime immigrants, while supporting the administration's tax bill and tariff proposals.
candidates.primary_result: Unopposed in Aug 18, 2026 Republican primary (CBS Miami)

candidates.name: Phil "Felipe" Ehr
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Phil 'Felipe' Ehr is a retired U.S. Navy commander who served from 1982 to 2008, including roles supporting Cold War-era operations, Desert Storm and Allied Force; his campaign says he has since completed humanitarian aid delivery missions in Ukraine. He was the Democratic nominee in Florida's 1st District in 2020 and against Carlos Gimenez in CD 28 in 2024, and was unopposed in the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary. U.S. Rep. Jamie Raskin endorsed him in September 2026.

candidates.name: Eddy Rojas
candidates.background: Eddy Rojas is an independent (no party affiliation) candidate on the Nov. 3, 2026 ballot for District 28, making it a three-way race with Gimenez and Ehr. Ballotpedia says he was born in Cuba, immigrated to Miami, began his career as a valet and later established several companies; his platform says he plans to bring his business experience to Congress. No issue-specific positions were found.
